newsitem.title: GERMANY: EMI endorses euro fiscal stability pact.
newsitem.headline: EMI endorses euro fiscal stability pact.

text.p: The European Monetary Institute (EMI), the forerunner to the European Central Bank, on Tuesday said it endorsed plans for a stability pact to ensure strict budgetary control in the euro zone.

A stability and growth pact, which will penalise countries participating in the single currency if their budget deficits rise to exceed Maastricht Treaty reference levels, was agreed by the European council in Dublin last December.

European finance ministers and central bank governors agreed the final details of the pact at a meeting earlier this month in the Dutch seaside town of Noordwijk and the pact is due to be ratified by government leaders at a summit in June.
In its annual report, the EMI reaffirmed its commitment to the pact and said it approved of plans to tighten up the conditions under which sanctions will be imposed.
"The EMI endorses the objective of strengthening the credibility and effectiveness of the excessive deficit procedure," the report said.
"This framework should be as transparent and precise as possible, in accordance with the principles of the Treaty..," the EMI said.
